glossary.definition: (1) "Electronic pollbook" means an electronic list of registered voters for a particular precinct or polling location that may be transported to a polling location.
glossary.source_title: Section 3506.05 - Certification of voting and tabulating equipment.

glossary.definition: (2) Except when used as part of the phrase "tabulating equipment" or "automatic tabulating equipment," "equipment" means a voting machine, marking device, automatic tabulating equipment, software, an electronic pollbook, a voter registration system, or a ballots on demand voting system.
